# Shia Rishta

> Nikah-first Shia matrimony platform. Privacy-first profiles, mutual-interest
> messaging, and wali / guardian workflows built in. Free to join.

Shia Rishta is for Shia Muslims seeking nikah (Islamic marriage), and for the
families and walis who support them. It is not a dating app: profiles are created
with marriage intent, there is no swiping, and privacy defaults are the most
restrictive available rather than the most permissive.

## Key facts

- Creating a profile, browsing, expressing interest, messaging a match and the
  guardian tools are all free. There is no payment system and no paid tier.
- Photos are private by default. A member chooses who sees them: everyone, only
  people with mutual interest, or only matches.
- Contact details are never published. A conversation opens only after interest
  is mutual, so nobody is notified of an unreciprocated approach.
- A wali or guardian link can be revoked by the member at any time, permanently.
- Identity verification is reviewed by a person and is never a precondition for
  browsing.

## Pages

- [Shia Rishta — nikah-first Shia matrimony](https://shiarishta.com/): Nikah-first Shia matrimony. Browse profiles, keep photos private, involve family with wali and guardian tools. Free to join.
  - **Is Shia Rishta really free?** Yes. Creating a profile, browsing, expressing interest and using guardian tools are all free, and core access is intended to stay free.
  - **Who can see my photos?** Only the people you choose: everyone, people you have mutual interest with, or only your matches. The default is the most private of those.
  - **Can my family or wali be involved?** Yes. Wali and guardian workflows are first-class: approvals, family introductions and chaperoned communication. A member can revoke a guardian link permanently at any time.
  - **Who can join Shia Rishta?** Serious Shia Muslims seeking nikah, along with parents, guardians and trusted matchmakers acting on their behalf.
  - **When can I start a conversation?** Only after interest is mutual. Nobody is notified of an unreciprocated approach, which removes the most common harassment vector on dating platforms.
  - **What is the difference from a generic dating app?** It is Shia-specific (sect, marja and practice fields that generic sites do not carry), privacy-first (photo tiers instead of a public gallery) and nikah-first (no swiping culture).

- [Privacy Policy](https://shiarishta.com/privacy): How Shia Rishta collects, encrypts and protects your personal data. Your photos, contact details and guardian links stay under your control.
- [Terms of Service](https://shiarishta.com/terms): The terms governing your use of Shia Rishta, the nikah-first Shia matrimony platform: who may join, what conduct is not allowed, and what we do not guarantee.
- [About Shia Rishta](https://shiarishta.com/about): Why Shia Rishta exists: a dignified, nikah-first alternative to swiping for Shia Muslims and their families, built on privacy-first photos and wali involvement.
- [Safety and verification standards](https://shiarishta.com/safety): How Shia Rishta keeps members safe: identity verification, photo privacy tiers, mutual-interest messaging and human review.
- [How Shia Rishta works](https://shiarishta.com/success-stories): How Shia Rishta actually works: verified profiles, mutual-interest messaging, privacy controls and family-supported introductions. No invented stories.
- [Contact Shia Rishta](https://shiarishta.com/contact): Reach the Shia Rishta team with questions, privacy or takedown requests, safety reports and partnership enquiries. Members can also raise a request here.
- [Nikah and marriage guidance](https://shiarishta.com/blog): Practical guidance on nikah, choosing a spouse, and married life for Shia Muslims — written for serious seekers and their families.
- [Shia community and guidance](https://shiarishta.com/community): Community guidance and events for Shia Muslims preparing for nikah — the discussions, advice and community that happen before a profile ever does.
- [Help and support](https://shiarishta.com/support): Get help with your Shia Rishta account, identity verification, privacy settings and messaging. Raising a request from your dashboard gets a faster answer.
- [Writing a strong Shia rishta profile](https://shiarishta.com/profile-guide): Worked examples of strong Shia marriage profiles: how to write about deen, expectations, family and timeline so real families reach back.

- [Create your free account](https://shiarishta.com/auth/register): Create a free Shia Rishta profile for nikah — privacy-first photos, wali and guardian workflows, and no payment required.

## Access and usage

- Member profiles at `/profiles` are public and browsable without an account.
- Member-only areas (`/dashboard`, `/messages`, `/settings`, `/admin`) require an
  account and are excluded here on purpose.
- Privacy requests and takedown requests: https://shiarishta.com/contact
- Full policy: https://shiarishta.com/privacy

## Accuracy note

Member counts, verification counts and city breakdowns are deliberately NOT stated
here. They change continuously and cannot be known at build time, so quoting a
number would go stale and could be wrong within days. The live figures are
available at https://shiarishta.com/api/profiles/stats and are rendered on the
homepage. No testimonials or success stories are published because no member has
consented to one.
